description: This file contains multiple class definitions implementing extension interfaces, each providing methods that perform extension checks, message passing, and generic extensions within a testing context for Orleans grains.

classes.name: TestExtension
classes.description: Implements ITestExtension, providing methods to check grain extension properties and messaging.

classes.name: SimpleExtension
classes.description: Implements ISimpleExtension, returning a stored string value.

classes.name: AutoExtension
classes.description: Implements IAutoExtension, provides a static message.

classes.name: GenericTestExtension<T>
classes.description: A generic extension class implementing IGenericTestExtension<T>, allowing extension logic for grains with generic types.

methods.name: CheckExtension_1
methods.description: Returns the ExtensionProperty of the grain.

methods.name: CheckExtension_2
methods.description: Retrieves a grain via grainFactory and calls GetLabel().
